oracle_provenance: UCB1 multi-armed-bandit algorithm (Auer, Cesa-Bianchi & Fischer 2002), standard textbook reinforcement learning; independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded UCB1 score for ranking a candidate next experiment, gated by a separately-evaluated risk-gate flag; not an override of risk authority.

cases.question: For an arm with relatively few trials, does the UCB score include a substantial exploration bonus above the raw mean?
For the same mean reward but far more trials on this arm, does the exploration bonus shrink, correctly reflecting reduced uncertainty?
Must an arm trial count exceeding the total trial count be rejected as structurally impossible?
Even with a high UCB score, does a failed risk gate block the experiment outright, confirming the score never overrides risk authority?
